harness: frontend/perf/avatar-bench.html (real RenderOnlineUsers/PlayerController/DebugBridge over a mocked SpacetimeDB store, game camera polar 0.78 azimuth 0.45 distance 18 fov 42), run by frontend/perf/run-bench.mjs; headless Chromium, SwiftShader, 800x500 CSS px, DPR 1, 15 s per count; odd avatars walk one tile every other tick; spread 3 tiles (outer rows off screen at 64).
qualification: Shared 4-core container with other agents' browsers running (load 5-15). SwiftShader rasterizes on the CPU, so frame interval is GPU-emulation bound and noisy; cpuFrameMs (useFrame + gl.render submission, r3f addEffect->addAfterEffect) and reactCommitMsPerSecond (React Profiler around the avatar tree) are the CPU signals. Draw calls are deterministic.

frameIntervalMsP50.note: SwiftShader-bound and dominated by host contention; not comparable run to run
